title: Gym or fitness studio site
when: The user wants a site for a gym, yoga studio, dance school, martial arts or personal trainer.
prompt:
Goal: Show the classes and timetable clearly and convert visitors into a first trial visit.
Steps:
1. Hero with the promise and a Book a free class action if a trial exists.
2. Weekly schedule as a table with day headers on wide screens and a per day list on phones.
3. Class descriptions: level, duration, what to bring.
4. Membership options with prices and what is included.
5. Trainers with credentials the user provided; location and hours at the end.
Quality bar:
- Schedule is readable at 375 px.
- Levels are explained in plain words.
- Strong contrast for energetic colors.
Pitfalls:
- A schedule image no one can read.
- Neon text on dark that fails contrast.
- Unclear trial terms.
Verify:
- [ ] Schedule table has th headers.
- [ ] Prices include the period.
- [ ] Trial action present.
- [ ] No overflow on phones.
Output: index.html and style.css with schedule, classes, plans and contact.

examples.input: site para estúdio de yoga com horários
examples.output: hero with free trial, weekly timetable table, class levels, 3 membership plans
